name: Neo-Grid Bold
avoid_for: Contexts that need to feel quiet, traditional, or warm — the neon-yellow accent and uppercase display commit to a confident editorial voice
weak_cases: Long labels can collide with fixed spans; typography and panels must be composed together.
visual_signature: Paper/ink/lemon panel adjacency with heavy uppercase type locked to grid spans.

provenance.adaptation: Recipe retained and curated for Deck Studio; selector describes source-supported structures, not rendered acceptance.

language_posture: Uppercase and compact Latin headings do not predict other-script fit; recompose spans around actual text.

assets.images: No image required; type, shapes and surface treatments can carry the system.
